status: vertical mechanism test frozen after x-y-time-only preflight and before vertical output
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism test; four-panel subset only; cannot alter v0.3.8 or generalize to Eidolon

ecological_hypotheses.shared_night_context: Residual vertical individuality is largely generated by broad environmental context shared by animals on the same calendar night.
ecological_hypotheses.persistent_individual_context: Same-individual history remains more predictive than contemporaneous other individuals even after matching 2-km horizontal place and broad kinematic state.

context.night_rule: UTC timestamp shifted backward by 12 hours, then calendar date
context.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session's median primary height before selecting kinematic endpoints

predictors.self_history: equal-session P(z_residual | 2-km cell,state) from same individual's other retained sessions in same cohort
predictors.same_night_other: equal-individual P(z_residual | 2-km cell,state) from other individuals assigned to target shifted night in same cohort
predictors.target_scoring: target endpoints whose 2-km cell×state stratum is supported by both predictors

calibration.preserve: session night, x-y-time-derived state, centered vertical outcomes and exact per-cohort individual session-count multiset
calibration.panel_statistic: equal-individual mean self-history minus same-night-other log-score gain
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact observed preflight n; observed-minus-null-mean panel statistic >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

decision_matrix.3_or_4_pass: Within the four structurally evaluable panels, broad shared calendar-night context is insufficient as a general explanation after 2-km fine-place and kinematic matching.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Night-context contribution is mixed across the structurally evaluable panels.
decision_matrix.0_pass: Shared calendar-night context can account for much of the residual under this proxy, subject to support and power.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to Eidolon and no claim that exact local wind/uplift was matched.

claim_boundary: Calendar-night matching is a broad temporal-context proxy, not direct weather matching.
Persistence does not prove intrinsic phenotype.
Subset and n were fixed before vertical outcome.
stop_rule: Do not change exact n, 2-km grid, speed2_turn2 state, night rule, purity, centering, vertical bins, 50-event support, B/seeds or pass criteria after output.
If exact observed n fails to reproduce, invalidate rather than retune.
